summary: Dmytro Khimchenko's audit and talks portfolio. The home page loads only its own files, but a talk page with a recording embeds a YouTube player as it opens, third-party code the visitor has not asked for. No public source of the site was found: the linked repository holds audit reports only. That is why it stays at Level 2.
